verdict.rationale: PayPal documents one build-it-yourself path: Agent Ready's ACP guide has Braintree merchants publish an MCP server with a `complete_checkout` tool and specify Braintree as provider, without any stated access request. The other main paths are gated. Agentic commerce services and Store Sync require a form submission and follow-up from PayPal's AI team, and UCP requires contacting Google for enablement. Missing for 10: a truly self-serve toggle or agreement for agentic commerce services/Store Sync, self-serve UCP enablement, availability beyond existing Braintree merchants, and independent corroboration that the ACP path is self-serve end to end.

support.subject: As a merchant, I have a documented self-serve path to start accepting agent traffic — enable a setting, sign an agreement, or publish an endpoint

citations.quote: Use this guide to build a custom ChatGPT app that accepts payments using the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and the ChatGPT Apps SDK.
